title: Dinosaur Eggs Have Never Been Discovered This Far South Before - Nautilus
gist: Short teaser: a Royal Society Open Science study reports dinosaur eggs found farther south than ever before, with researchers hypothesizing how the clutch was kept warm; the excerpt gives no location or data.
